counts.condition: Operating, latest listing, no classification conflict; five normal reports and recent post-2023 evidence

limitations: Fiscal periods ending in 2020–2023 are excluded from these normal-year columns only. Raw observations and prior all-year models remain intact.
Five normal reports are selected before examining missing values. No older substitution fills a missing selected metric.
The two capital-return ratios are closing-balance accounting proxies, not normalized ROIC or ROTCE.
Tangible-asset intensity and historical margins do not establish maintenance investment, inflation protection or pricing power.
Normal value is a separate flat median-provider-FCF projection: ten years, 10% required return, zero growth. Provider FCF is not reconciled owner cash.
Old nominal cash can underrepresent a larger modern business. No inflation or scale adjustment is inferred.
A 30% discount to full modeled value requires 42.857142857% NPV/price. Half-terminal >=0 is redundant under this fixed flat-cash model, not an independent signal.
Missing or mismatched-currency price comparisons are withheld. Cash PV remains in reporting currency.
The companion watch screen has no discount condition and does not identify all matches as undervalued.
Quotes are frozen observations, not current prices. Multiple listings may represent the same issuer; no return probability or purchase recommendation follows.
